unitTitle: Subject/Object Personal Pronouns - The verb 'to be' - Have got - Can - Present Simple - Present Continuous

pairsWith.noteUz: Bu nazariya beti Coursebook 1-unit grammatikasini davom ettiradi: have got qisqa javoblari, can, Present Simple shakli.

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 1-UNIT NAZARIYA, 2-BET (5-bet, PDF 4). Yuqorida o'ngda ko'k '1', sarlavha takrorlanadi. Och pushti ramka.

'Short answers' (have got): Have you/they got a dog? - Yes, I/we/they have. No, I/we/they haven't. Has he/she/it got brown eyes? - Yes, he/she/it has. No, he/she/it hasn't.

'The verb "can"' jadvali: Affirmative: I can dance. He/She/It can dance. We/You/They can dance. Interrogative: Can I dance? Can he/she/it dance? Can we/you/they dance? Negative - Long form: I cannot dance. He/She/It cannot dance. We/You/They cannot dance. Short form: I can't dance. He/She/It can't dance. We/You/They can't dance.
'Use': • We use can to show ability. 'She can swim.' • We also use can for polite requests. 'Can I come with you, please?'
'Short answers': Can I/you/he etc ... speak Spanish? - Yes, I/you/he etc can. No, I/you/he etc can't.

'Present Simple' jadvali: Affirmative: I work, you work, he works, she works, it works, we work, you work, they work. Interrogative: Do I work? Do you work? Does he work? Does she work? Does it work? Do we work? Do you work? Do they work? Negative - Long form: I do not work, you do not work, he does not work, she does not work, it does not work, we do not work, you do not work, they do not work. Short form: I don't work, you don't work, he doesn't work, she doesn't work, it doesn't work, we don't work, you don't work, they don't work.
'Form': • We form the present simple with the subject (noun or personal pronoun) and the verb. Affirmative: The third person singular takes -s or -es in the affirmative. 'I play - he plays, I go - he goes'. Negative: We use subject + don't + base form of the verb in all persons except the third person singular. We use subject + doesn't + base form of the verb in the third person singular. 'I don't play, he doesn't play, we don't play'. Interrogative: We use do + subject + base form of the verb in all persons except for the third person singular. We use does + subject + base form of the verb in the third person singular. 'Do you live in Brighton? Does he work with you?'

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '5'.

exercises.instructionEn: Affirmative: I/you/we/they work, he/she/it works. Interrogative: Do I/you/we/they work? Does he/she/it work? Negative: I/you/we/they do not (don't) work, he/she/it does not (doesn't) work. Form: We form the present simple with the subject (noun or personal pronoun) and the verb. The third person singular takes -s or -es in the affirmative: I play - he plays, I go - he goes. Negative: subject + don't + base form (all persons except third person singular); subject + doesn't + base form (third person singular): I don't play, he doesn't play, we don't play. Interrogative: do + subject + base form; does + subject + base form (third person singular): Do you live in Brighton? Does he work with you?
exercises.instructionUz: Tasdiq: I/you/we/they work, he/she/it works. So'roq: Do I/you/we/they work? Does he/she/it work? Inkor: I/you/we/they do not (don't) work, he/she/it does not (doesn't) work. Shakl: Present simple ega (ot yoki olmosh) + fe'l bilan yasaladi. 3-shaxs birlikda tasdiq shaklda -s yoki -es qo'shiladi: I play - he plays, I go - he goes. Inkor: ega + don't + fe'l asosiy shakli (3-shaxs birlikdan tashqari); ega + doesn't + fe'l (3-shaxs birlik): I don't play, he doesn't play, we don't play. So'roq: do + ega + fe'l; does + ega + fe'l (3-shaxs birlik): Siz Braytonda yashaysizmi? U siz bilan ishlaydimi?
